title: GuideAI Health Announces Marketing and Communications Programs
description: BOSTON, July 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- GuideAI Health Corp. (Cboe CA: GDAI) ("GuideAI" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has engaged Upswitch Media Corp. ("Upswitch") and BTV-Business Television ("BTV") — to execute a coordinated marketing, communications and investor-awareness program (the "Program"). The Program is designed to raise awareness of the Company and its artificial intelligence (AI) platform for the detection and characterization of vascular disease among the news, investment and healthcare communities.
